gloss: conveniently; luckily; as suits one's purposes

definitions.explanation: Things working out in a way that happens to suit the situation or the person. Can be genuinely positive.

definitions.gloss: self-servingly; in a way that suits one's own interests
definitions.explanation: Interpreting or arranging things to serve one's own convenience or advantage. Carries a critical nuance, suggesting someone is being selectively convenient.

examples.japanese: {都合|つごう}よく⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いていた→空く：11062_aku⟧。
{都合|つごう}よく⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|や}んだ→止む：01153_yamu⟧。
⟦{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れて→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧、{都合|つごう}よく⟦{晴|は}れて→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The weather forecast was wrong, and fortunately it cleared up for us.

examples.japanese: {都合|つごう}よく⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}するな→解釈する：26837_kaishakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Don't interpret things to suit yourself.

examples.english: You're changing the story to suit yourself.

notes:
The adverbial form of ⟦{都合|つごう}がいい→都合がいい：22997_tsugougaii⟧ (convenient, favorable). In sense 1, it describes fortunate timing or circumstances. In sense 2, it implies someone is being self-serving or naively optimistic. Context and tone determine which nuance is intended.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都合|つごう}よく⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}する→解釈する：26837_kaishakusuru⟧: to interpret self-servingly
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{都合|つごう}よく: to suit oneself
- {都合|つごう}よく⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to conveniently forget

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{好都合|こうつごう}→好都合：16849_koutsugou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: conveniently — more formal; emphasizes favorable circumstances
- ⟦{折|おり}→折：10250_ori⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: opportunely, at a good time — emphasizes timing
- ⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧: fortunately — a broader term for general good luck
